shape.text: A Grok API key begins with xai-, shown in the provider's quickstart and in its management API reference.

The key's body after the prefix is 80 characters. The provider's API-key response schema shows one example with an 80-character alphanumeric body and its prose never states the length, so this is documented by example. A third-party error message that masks a key (LiteLLM) also shows an 80-character body.

Every positive example body uses letters and digits only. Scanner rules disagree about whether underscore and hyphen may appear: one admits an underscore, another admits both, and others accept letters and digits only.
It is not established whether the body can contain an underscore or a hyphen.

unresolved.reason: The documentation never states the alphabet in prose, and no real key containing an underscore or hyphen was seen.

shape.text: It is not established how a key followed by further word characters should be read.

unresolved.reason: Scanner rules differ on a value with an 81st word character: one rejects it, one truncates to 80 and one anchors exactly; no provider source settles it.

issuance.text: A key is created from the API Keys page of the xAI console, belongs to a team, and its full value is returned once at creation. The official Python SDK reads XAI_API_KEY and validates nothing.

unresolved.reason: No key was issued for this research; the console flow and the show-once behaviour are recorded in a research note without a cited page.

collisions.text: A management key (XAI_MANAGEMENT_KEY) for the Management API is a separate credential. One scanner reports an xai-token- prefix followed by 80 characters.

unresolved.reason: Provider documentation gives no format for a management key; only a scanner source reports an xai-token- prefix.

collisions.text: Public values next to keys include the apiKeyId and teamId UUIDs, access-control strings such as api-key:endpoint:chat, the xai-org and xai-sdk names, and the redacted form of xai- followed by an ellipsis and four characters. A Groq gsk_ value stored under XAI_API_KEY is not an xAI key.

unresolved.reason: Recorded in a research note without a cited source.
